name: Dupin
quote: To seek for evidence and deduce the truth is a battle of the mind, with a wealth of clues abound.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. The sky is a little too bright for me. Would you mind if I closed the shades?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Hmm... I can sense something strange from you that fades in and out... Perhaps it is my imagination.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Nights in the Oasis are often very quiet. I enjoy such environments that are conducive to contemplation.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Professor? Did you just come back from a nighttime stroll?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: A true detective ought to have a pair of eyes that see clearly and are not deceived by the surface appearance of things. At times, the devil really does lie in those details that others fail to notice.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: They have plumage that blends in with the night, yet they love collecting sparkly baubles. Crows really are an extraordinary species of avian, aren't they? Clever, cunning, and stealthy, just like... phantom thieves.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: You've been quiet for a while now. I was starting to wonder if my pocket watch was broken.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Hm? You're interested in the workings of my cane? Careful, it's sharper than you think. The sword within it is just one of several means of self-defense. You can come closer if you'd like to know more.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Good reflexes.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Haha, interesting!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: What do you have in mind?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: I accept this charge.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Dupin the Detective is here to discern the truth from the finest details. What further secrets can your eyes see?

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: May my eyes and my instincts grow ever keener!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Do I seek the joy of approaching the truth, or one round of mysteries after another?

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Thank you for the instruction. My final blind spot is finally clear to me, and now I shall see all there is to see.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: It would be my pleasure.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: A clue lies ahead.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: None shall escape!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Is that all there is to your deceptions?

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Checkmate.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I cannot... leave things like this...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: I definitely did not anticipate such a development... Although I realize now that I had seen the signs for it already. Being that I have no countermeasures prepared, how could I possibly refuse you? That being the case, all I can do is humbly accept this offer.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: The lively atmosphere and luxurious decorations make it very easy to forget essential details. However, I'll take note of all of them, so all you need to do is lose yourself in looking forward to the new year. Happy New Year, Professor.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Rather than fancy new flavors in gaudy but impractical packaging, I prefer chocolate squares like these in simple foil wrap. Classic detective stories have the purest flavor, and so it goes with chocolate. I saved you a piece; would you like to try it?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: They say "Tanabata" comes from the Far East, and on this day, magpies form a bridge to reunite two star-crossed lovers. If I were to stand on that bridge, who would I encounter? Would it be a rival, or a lover... What do you think, Professor?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: There are countless classic cases in my database. If you wish to reproduce a realistic scenario... Hm? You just want to give this place a bit of Halloween flavor? It seems I've let my imagination run away with me again. Very well, then I'll lend you a raven to perch on your shoulder.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: A Christmas cake's gone missing, you say? I'm sure there must be more to this than meets the eye. We've put so much effort into preparing for the festival; if we allow ourselves to fall into panic, we'll have fallen prey to the mastermind's schemes... What? It was eaten by someone?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. All important days deserve to be remembered, and naturally, the day of your birth is one of them. Shall we open a bottle of champagne to celebrate? If you can't hold your liquor well, you may choose any drink you wish.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud.

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Have you ever carefully observed someone and obtained interesting information from them?
That is how a detective works, piecing together the truth from the smallest details. Learning how to observe a person in detail is the secret to grasping their true nature more quickly and more thoroughly, and by doing so, you will clear away your doubts, solve the riddles before you, and behold the truth. This is more than what humanity wishes for Dolls, it is also the ultimate goal in the depths of my neural cloud.
If there is something you truly cannot figure out, feel free to ask me about it. Perhaps I might be able to help clear your mind.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
You want an introduction to observing others? Allow me to give you an example. Every person's actions illustrate their habits. Deducing their emotional states and mental activity from seemingly insignificant actions is part of my job.
For instance, your light drumming of your fingers on the table several minutes ago suggests your boredom with information analysis, and then the way you put your cup down after that indicated that the problem was solved. My guess is that the way you rested your jaw on your right hand just now was a sign of contemplation...
What? I was right about the first two, but the last one was simply because you were tired? ...Ahem. Indeed, there are cases where one can read too deeply into simple things.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Hm? This is... Yes, I was just about to get up to look for that record. How did you find it?
I see. So you were also observing me while I was observing you? It seems you took even my subconscious thoughts into consideration as well. Things are getting more interesting now. Perhaps you too have a professional detective's eye.
Perhaps the two of us might be able to open up new possibilities in deductive reasoning together.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
What are you looking at? These articles all concern—ah, they're nothing more than old editorials. 
In every era, there are always ruthless and wanton people who call themselves "Phantom Thieves". Naturally, I won't let them get away with their misdeeds. To me, LeBlanc is a formidable challenge, and I once found myself confounded by his schemes. While some believe that a single failure is enough to topple an ace detective from grace, never to be restored, it does not bother me. 
What DOES bother me is whether this chase is in keeping with my true nature or because I've lost my initial desire to bring him to justice?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
"What is worth pursuing is not the person who once overcame you, but the riddle that must be unraveled step by step..." 
Indeed. It was precisely because of my obsession that he rose to challenge me again after being defeated by me. 
Relax, Professor. If I can catch him once, I can catch him again. 
Once we return to the real world, I will engrave your reminder in my heart and then bring this chase to its conclusion. When the time comes, I hope you will not look away.

voices.label: Understanding
voices.text: Everything is under control.

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: I see.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Hm...

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Heh, heh, heh...

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Hm?

career:
The DetectiveD is a specialized detective-type Doll produced by Universal Anything Services. It is equipped with the most advanced CPU on the market, and its recording, analysis, and linguistic modules can be run in multithread mode, allowing the DetectiveD to function more efficiently in complex, changing environments than others of its kind. The other special feature of the DetectiveD is its "deep" database, which tremendously enhances its ability to analyze human facial expressions and body language and allows it to divine the deeper meaning of such signs. 

In 2053, the Montmartre Detective Agency in Paris purchased Dupin, the first of the DetectiveD line. In 2055, he became the agency's head detective after breaking a series of missing-object cases involving highly valuable items, as well as joining the local police department's "Backlog Clearing" plan as a consultant. After that, Dupin's wealth of experience and the strings pulled by his agency secured him a place in Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
Before his transfer to the Montmartre Detective Agency, Dupin spent his time performing various experiments and tests for future generations of the DetectiveD model. Thanks to UAS' cutting-edge sensor and data-analysis technology, he delivered an impeccable performance in his professional trials with the only difficulty coming from the AI-related experimental phase. 

Decryption games were like simple math problems to Dupin, who had long since been familiar with them, and he could easily point out logical blind spots in famous detective novels. Even the popular detective anime "Specky Shorty" was like a comedy to him. The only time he showed any expression other than bored resignation on his face was when the project team, who viewed it as a challenge to them, began grabbing pending and unsolved cases from the local police department for his perusal. 

"He wasn't happy with the test material I gave him... Not a while after watching that movie, and it was a classic, mind you, and he was already sighing about it! Why? Why else? He thought it was too simple! I couldn't understand it even after several re-watches, and he complained it was too simple... You should have seen the look on his face. He took a little breath, then exhaled it even more gently than when it came in. Of course I'm hurt! I love this stuff, and he regarded it as trash!" "Um, look on the bright side; at least he finished watching the whole thing with you..." —A broken-hearted and thoroughly intoxicated research director for the DetectiveD speaking with a shiny-headed software engineer

When the article "Shocking News! An Experimental UAS Doll Cracks a Long Backlog of Unsolved Cases!" was published, it instantly sparked an explosion of public debate. Despite the high price of DetectiveD Dolls, orders came in from all around the globe, and one special order was targeted at Dupin himself. 

Dupin's name came from the name of a detective from a novel series by Edgar Allan Poe, and the boss of the Montmartre Detective Agency was a big fan of the writer. Even running a detective agency was merely a hobby rather than a way to support his lifestyle. Therefore, when he learned that a prototype Doll named after the character in all these cases... the boss immediately placed a purchase order for Dupin with the same fervor used for buying merchandise. Upon receiving the news, the project head was both reluctant yet relieved to comply, and so he happily put Dupin into a shipping crate and sent him off. 

Thus began Dupin's career as a detective.

Dupin did not actually go the way of being a real piece of merchandise and ending up as an ornament. After all, as a fan of the book in question, having Dupin from "The Murders in the Rue Morgue" step out of its pages and solve cases was what his boss wanted. 

"Do you close the curtains in the daytime?" his boss often asked Dupin, along with other questions that appeared equally nonsensical to outsiders. Dupin knew these questions came from his name, but it did not affect him. His own skills were what had brought him here, not his resemblance to a certain literary character. Dupin was fully aware of exactly who he was, and that was why he never allowed himself to be led astray by the unique attitude his boss had for him. Upon joining the agency, he started out as an assistant, absorbing the knowledge his database did not possess and digesting knowledge that his neural cloud had not verified before. By the time he became the agency's head detective, even his harshest critics in the firm could not doubt his worthiness for the position. 

However, at some point, Dupin had grown fond of contemplating matters late at night, like an actual detective in stories. Perhaps a quiet night was the best sort of windbreaker for a private investigator.

Every detective has their moments of failure, and naturally, Dupin has had his share of setbacks. In Paris, the city of art, Dupin encountered a "phantom thief" who specialized in stealing expensive objets d'art—LeBlanc. This was the first time he had ever allowed a rogue to slip away from him, and thus Dupin treated the matter of LeBlanc with the utmost seriousness and motivation. Before long, he managed to score a victory over the latter. After that, the two of them began a long-running battle of wits that went back and forth many times. Upon learning that LeBlanc had joined Project Neural Cloud, Dupin immediately sought his boss's help. The latter, who had been utterly taken with Dupin's actions, which perfectly suited the trope of "the lead character pursuing his nemesis", was highly enthusiastic about it and gave his all to recommend Dupin for Project Neural Cloud. 

Dupin's professional knowledge meant that he was cautious and alert in daily life, and that did not change even after joining Project Neural Cloud and arriving at Magrasea, where life was much simpler in general. As a result, he ended up doing things like monitoring the movements of Dolls sent on field expeditions, analyzing the motives of Kuro in hosting the live stream program "Detecting the Detective!" , investigating why Daiyan played the guzheng late at night, and so on. 

"I've never seen anyone as suspicious... No, perhaps I should say, as idle as he."—renowned author in the Oasis.

Dupin's arrival at the Oasis was nothing short of a disaster for the Oasis' pranksters, as no snare of theirs could hide from Dupin's eyes. In the past, they used to work independently and struggle on their own in the shadows, but with Dupin's arrival, they have abandoned their individual differences and begun to work together, even developing into a small group of their own with a single objective: get the better of Dupin. However, the first to accomplish this was actually Persicaria. 

"Miss Persicaria, the amount of sugar in your coffee is well in excess of 900% the recommended intake. Was someone playing a prank... Wait, you added it yourself? How could that be?" 

In addition to easily seeing through traps, another thing that surprised everyone was how Dupin managed to get along so well with the eternal rivals Zangyin and Nora at the same time. According to Zangyin, Dupin was genuinely interested in her folk tales and urban legends, and she was also glad to share all the mysterious sights she had seen with him. However, Zangyin was far more willing to share the account of how Nora came to know Dupin. She had presented her brand new detective novel to him as a meeting present, but the latter finished it in no time at all and pointed out various plot holes that could have been improved. 

"Hm? Yes, I know they get along well too, but that doesn't get in the way of my fun! Just thinking about smug dorks getting called out on their mistakes fills me with delight." —A certain anti-fan of a renowned Oasis author.
oathDesc: Solving the most difficult of mysteries requires some rationality, wisdom, and just a little love.

projections.name: A Time For Shrewdness
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"A professional detective needs to carefully analyze the logic of the case details, but more importantly, they have to be determined enough to find the clues that they need."

projections.name: Chamber of Contemplation
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Overly bright days do not suit me. A detective's leisure time is spent with the shades closed and enjoying the pleasures of cogitation."

skinList.name: Spring Invitation
skinList.desc:
First Bloom — A school uniform suitable for early spring, custom-made for the school nurse and stirring the heart to early flutters.
He doesn't seem too happy with the pile of chocolates in the health room. His back is to the window outside which flowers bloom. Clearly, he has been waiting for a while."Are you feeling unwell? No... judging by the look on your face, you must have something to hand to me, don't you?"

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
True desires slip forth unwittingly as Dolls take on new forms with the help of mysterious powers. Reality and fiction interweave; take care to not be too absorbed in a fool's game.
""Small as I might be, my wits are still as good as ever! I am the great detective... Dupin!""
